text.en:
Today you learn to say what you will do later.
I will wait outside.
It means: I am not outside yet, but I will be.
She will call later.
It means: the call comes after some time.

Put will before the action.
I will wait. She will wait. We will wait.
The little word will never changes.
After will, the next word stays short.
He will open the gate.

You will say what you decide or promise.
Think: what will I do?
Put will before it.
We will split the bill.
I will put the kettle on.
